overview.text: Manifold presents user-created prediction markets traded with Mana, a play-money currency with no cash-redemption value. Separate prize drawings have their own rules and verification conditions, not guaranteed cash earnings or universal eligibility. Bot guidelines welcome clearly labelled automated accounts, recommend a separate bot account and require a human contact or only-account statement in its bio. Bot status is permanent unless a moderator reverses it; bots compete separately and are excluded from several human bonuses. Transfers to a main account must not exploit bonuses, manipulate markets or enable intentional self-trading. Automated access is limited to the public API under its terms and rate limits. Purchased Mana is non-refundable and cannot be cashed out.
